meta.name: flux-image
meta.description: Generate images with FLUX models (Black Forest Labs) via inference.sh CLI. Models: FLUX Dev LoRA, FLUX.2 Klein LoRA with custom style adaptation. Capabilities: text-to-image, image-to-image, LoRA fine-tuning, custom styles. Triggers: flux, flux.2, flux dev, flux schnell, flux pro, black forest labs, flux image, flux ai, flux model, flux lora

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用FLUX模型生成和编辑图像

copy.tagline_en: Generate and edit images with FLUX models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate or modify images with AI

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过命令行调用 FLUX 模型生成图像，支持文生图、图生图、LoRA 微调等。
howto.when: 当你提到“flux”、“flux dev”、“flux schnell”等关键词，或要求生成图像时触发。

say.text: 用 FLUX Dev 生成一张未来城市夜景图。
say.note: 调用高精度模型生成图像。

say.text: 用 FLUX.2 Klein 快速生成一张抽象艺术图。
say.note: 调用快速模型生成图像。

say.text: 用 FLUX Dev LoRA 把这张图变成水彩风格。
say.note: 图生图并应用 LoRA 风格。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate images using FLUX models via CLI, supporting text-to-image, image-to-image, and LoRA fine-tuning.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "flux", "flux dev", "flux schnell", or ask to generate an image.

say_en.text: Generate a futuristic city night scene with FLUX Dev.
Quickly generate an abstract art with FLUX.2 Klein.
Transform this image into watercolor style using FLUX Dev LoRA.
